result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.network_smooth()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Smooth node scores over the network topology. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L16286-L16351){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.network_smooth( scores, alpha=0.5, max_iter=100, tol=1e-06, attr_name=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} ![Smooth node scores over the network](/assets/graphs/network-smooth.light.svg){.lightbox fig-alt="Before: the shared seven-node graph with raw scores as badges, 1 on A, B and D and 0 elsewhere, the scored nodes outlined. After: the smoothed scores, shaded as heat. C, a 0 surrounded by scored neighbors, rises to 0.45, while the far triangle E, F, G stays near 0." width="100%"} Propagates noisy per-node scores (e.g., differential expression values) through the network to produce denoised estimates that incorporate neighborhood information. Uses iterative label spreading: `f(t+1) = alpha * W_norm * f(t) + (1 - alpha) * f(0)`. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [scores]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[int, float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping node IDs to initial scores. Nodes not in the dictionary default to 0.0. [alpha]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.5]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Smoothing strength between 0 and 1. Higher values give more weight to network neighbors. Lower values preserve the original signal. [max_iter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum number of iterations. [tol]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1e-06]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Convergence tolerance. [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : If provided, store the smoothed scores as a node attribute with this name. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, return the smoothed scores as a dictionary. If `False`, store the result and return `self` for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph | dict[int, float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Smoothed scores (if `return_dict=True`) or `self`. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#a813c9ba .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph() for i in range(5): g.add_node(label=str(i)) for i in range(4): g.add_edge(source=str(i), target=str(i + 1)) scores = {g.get_id_from_label("0"): 10.0, g.get_id_from_label("4"): -5.0} smoothed = g.network_smooth(scores, alpha=0.5, return_dict=True) smoothed ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {5: -2.82738085341407, 3: 0.4166668653488159, 1: 5.744047718762886, 4: -1.3095240079564974, 2: 2.9761902772588655} ``` ::: :::
